campaign.email_body:
Hey {{contact.first_name|Hey}},

I hope you’ve been enjoying GravityView!


I wanted to give you a quick heads up on what’s included in our GravityView + Extensions license and why you should consider upgrading.

  • Access to ALL GravityView premium extensions
    Our powerful suite of premium extensions allows you to do so much more with GravityView.

  • Advanced filtering capabilities
    Limit entry visibility to the user who created them. Advanced Filters gives you finer control over which entries display in a View.

  • DataTables support
    Display Gravity Forms data in a live-updating table with extended sorting, filtering and exporting capabilities.

If you’re interested in upgrading or just want to find out more, you can learn more about GravityView + Extensions here:

Go to GravityView + Extensions

Either way, let me know if you have any questions, and thanks again for being part of our community! 🙌


All the best,


Zack Katz

Founder of GravityKit


P.S. You can also upgrade to our All Access Pass and get our full suite of Gravity Forms add-ons!
